newsitem.title: USA: Mich. early retirement plan nets 5,169 employees.
newsitem.headline: Mich. early retirement plan nets 5,169 employees.

text.p: A total of 5,169 Michigan state employees have sought early retirement under a plan proposed by Gov. John Engler, the state management and budget department announced Tuesday.
Engler had expected approximately 3,500 to 4,000 state employees to seek early retirement when he announced the incentive plan last November, the department said in a statement.
The state anticipates saving $50 million annually, including $16.5 million from the general fund, under the early out program, Budget Director Mark Murray said.
The actual number of participants may change slightly if applications are subsequently found ineligible, Murray noted.

Michigan Department of Transportation will lose 537 unemployees under the plan. Management and Budget has 132 employees seeking early retirement. Another 131 employees of the Michigan Treasurer's office have also sought early retirement.
